create_NymeriaDataProvider: create a NymeriaDataProvider instance from a sequence root directory path with optional body model and recording flags
get_synced_poses: get synchronized poses and body skeleton data for all recordings at a given global timestamp in nanoseconds
get_all_pointclouds: get all filtered semidense point clouds from every loaded recording as a dictionary of numpy arrays
get_synced_rgb_videos: get synchronized RGB video frames from head and observer recordings at a given global timestamp
T_Hd_Hx: get the SE3 transform from Aria headset to XSens head coordinates at a given timestamp with interpolation
